name: VF-3SS

source.note: Summary of Haas's published specs, not yet checked against the spec sheet.

about: Example machine model file. The Super Speed VF-3: inline direct-drive spindle, faster rapids and feeds, and a side-mount tool changer. Travel, group and types come from haas.vf3.
notes: Lower table load than the VF-3 and a coarser ballscrew; neither changes the program. Tool changer capacity varies by build: published specs show 24+1 and 30+1 side-mount changers, and some machines have 40+1. Check the machine.
